scope: Read-only review of all five user attachment images; no source data or manuscript edited.

layout.rationale: Keep all residue-dense line plots and heatmaps full width. Only the structural composite and ten-position peptide curve share a row. Do not place the 45-position CDR track beside the 23-site Hchi bar chart.

panel_scope.a: Real complex overview + one close-up of Q72–beta53/Gly54; approximate 40/60 mm split within 109 mm. Real molecular close-up remains the first-row visual anchor.
panel_scope.b: All four peptide RMSF states and all ten peptide positions; compact two-column legend. P4/P10 vertical guide labels replace prose.
panel_scope.c: Both model states, all 45 aligned residues across all six CDRs. Separate CDR segments, with beta-CDR2 subtle highlight; Gly54 label stays concise.
panel_scope.d: All 23 valid interface positions ranked by delta-Hchi. Q72 receives teal emphasis and other positions a common neutral.
panel_scope.e: Full 3-by-45 TCR delta-RMSF heatmap. Six CDR group headers, all residue ticks, vertical colorbar at far right.
panel_scope.f: Full pMHC delta-Hchi heatmap. HLA and peptide group headers; all original positions retained, and invalid/unmatched cells visually distinguished from zero.

color_semantics: Use orange open circles for MEL5 and purple filled squares for alpha24beta17 everywhere absolute states are compared.
Use two additional restrained colors and distinct dashed/dotted lines for peptide mutants. Retain four-state legend labels that specify backgrounds.
Heatmaps must share negative/positive meaning and visual diverging palette, but keep independent numerical color scales for RMSF (A) and Hchi (nats).
The bar chart highlights Q72 in the same teal used for its molecular label, without implying those bars represent the state colors.
Do not recolor missing Hchi/invalid comparisons white, because white has the legitimate value zero.
specific_risks: Do not reuse the old 23/23/22 valid-count note or four-state labels without verifying exact source table.
Close-up distances and atom labels must remain legible at final 183 mm width; omit decorative prose before reducing atom text below 6 pt.
Cropping screenshot panels would leave inconsistent fonts, axes and partial heatmap colorbars. Redraw quantitative panels from verified numerical tables.
Heatmap colorbar belongs vertically at right to save height; include its quantity and unit so the two distinct scales are not confused.
Full-width curve/heatmap alignment should preserve intuitive CDR boundaries, even where pMHC width differs.
pass_conditions_for_new_composite: All six panels retain the data scopes shown in user attachments.
No title or annotation is smaller than 6 pt at print dimensions.
No panel letter/title overlap and no inter-row residue-label collision.
At 183 mm printed width the local Q72 contact labels, all heatmap residue IDs, and four-state legend are readable.
Shared colors encode shared conditions and continuous colors encode a different quantity with explicit units.
